How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
For US orders placed before 2 PM Arizona time on business days, processing typically takes one business day. Orders placed after 2 PM ship the next business day.
Once your package leaves our warehouse, tracking details are sent directly to your email.
If you'd like us to check your specific order, please share your order number and email address!

We are not liable for shipping delays caused by events beyond our reasonable control (such as severe weather, carrier disruptions, or customs processing).
Additionally, free shipping and standard services do not guarantee delivery dates. Any specific delivery guarantees apply only to select expedited carrier services and are subject to the carrier's own terms and conditions.
